mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with light drizzle near Verona Community Park, and with the Waning Gibbous moon out, we expect a low of 46 degrees overnight with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is celebrating Community Planning Month throughout October to honor the Planning and Development Department's commitment to our city. Additionally, the Senior Center is offering free rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is plenty to do today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art Bar Happy Hour, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report covering late September, police handled a situation on September 21 where a retail theft involving candy was identified through surveillance footage.

Today's flavor at the Verona Culver's is the always-popular Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to head over and enjoy a treat.
